page.overview:
Who is Baby Rosalina?

Baby Rosalina is a character in the Mario Kart series. She makes an appearance in Mario Kart 8, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Mario Kart Tour and Mario Kart World.

With an outfit based on Rosalina's design, Baby Rosalina has fair skin, platinum blonde hair, rosy cheeks, and bright blue eyes with four eyelashes (unlike her adult counterpart, which has six). Her hair is similar to the way Rosalina droops a large bang over her right eye as an adult. Her dress appears to be turquoise with a cyan skirt section. Her lower portion consists of a turquoise ruffled diaper cover over white tights and sapphire blue Mary Jane shoes with copper brown soles. Just like Rosalina, she wears a silver crown. She is equipped with a yellow pacifier.

Baby Rosalina's appearance contradicts her adult form's backstory. Despite Rosalina's Storybook showing Rosalina with red or strawberry blonde hair as a child, Baby Rosalina has the same color hair as her adult incarnation.

Like Baby Daisy, Pink Gold Peach and Toadette, Baby Rosalina first appears in a Mario Kart game. She is a light-class racer but has the stats of feather racers, including baby characters and Lemmy Koopa. Her only rival is Toadette.
